Run the log page ​

Leo Logs reads OpenRouter's BigQuery table and serves the pipelines and agents pages on 127.0.0.1. The default port is 8787. The command is leo-agent ui. The docs site is leologs.dev.

bash
export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/path/to/service-account.json
npm run ui

--port changes the port. It must be an integer from 1 to 65535.

Rows come from blueprint-8675309.openrouter.openrouter_traces, for the last 30 days, up to 200 rows. A pipeline or agent appears after OpenRouter has written at least one request that carries its trace id.

VariableRole
GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALSService-account JSON file. The page says what to set when this is missing.
BIGQUERY_PROJECTOverrides blueprint-8675309.
BIGQUERY_DATASETOverrides openrouter.
BIGQUERY_TABLEOverrides openrouter_traces.
